ja: 地球連合軍から、地球内の治安維持にも運用される警備型量産機「テックプロト」が登場！
■大型シールドが付属。新技術によりシールドの模様を１パーツで再現。
■バイザーの開閉状態を再現可能。
■リアスカートは背中への取り付けも可能。
■装甲パーツを取り外すことで軽装状態を再現可能。
■機体各箇所に可動ギミックを搭載。
en: From the Earth Alliance Forces, the mass-produced security aircraft "Tech Proto", which is also used to maintain public order on Earth, has arrived!
• Comes with a large seal. Using new technology, the Seal pattern is reproduced in one part.
• The opening and closing state of the visor can be reproduced.
• The rear skirt can also be attached to the back.
• Lightly armored condition can be reproduced by removing armored parts.
• Equipped with movable gimmicks in each part of the aircraft.

ja: グレネードランチャー×1
